steps.title: You bring a phone
steps.body: Broken, old, or simply too limited: we estimate its real value in under two minutes based on its condition and the West African market.

steps.title: TEKH+ turns it into a SWAP
steps.body: This is not a straight sale. Your device enters the certified Dealbox process: 50 checks, refurbishment, then exchange.

steps.title: You leave with another device
steps.body: Upgrade, equivalent device, or FCFA difference. The transaction is tracked, dropped at a collection point and handled through to handover.

items.question: What is Technical Residual Value (VRT) and how is it calculated?
items.answer: VRT is an estimate of your device’s remaining value. It considers the model, configuration, declared condition and local market. The final offer is confirmed after a physical check by a partner location.

items.question: How do device drop-off and payment work?
items.answer: After an online estimate, you receive instructions to continue with TEKH+. The physical check at a partner location validates the device’s actual condition before any transaction.

items.question: What if the actual condition differs from the online diagnosis?
items.answer: The partner location reviews the device with you. You may accept the adjusted offer or take your device back: no transaction is validated without your consent.

items.question: Is my personal data protected?
items.answer: Before trade-in, you remain responsible for backing up and resetting your phone. The Dealbox check helps guide you through this step before final validation.

items.question: How can I get help?
items.answer: Read this FAQ or contact TEKH+ by email or WhatsApp. Requests are handled by the team through the contact channels listed on the website.
